notes: PLATFORM (transfers to Frontgate S.N.37 and The Company Store S.N.38 - all Cornerstone Brands): IBM WebSphere Commerce (/wcsstore/CornerStoneBrands/) with a React 'PWA' storefront; product grids are served by Unbxd through the site's own same-origin proxy controller /UnbxdAPI. ACCESS: www.ballarddesigns.com 403s Akamai on a plain fetch and on r.jina.ai (Cloudflare challenge); curl_cffi with impersonate=chrome131 was served normally on the first try and carried every request. CATEGORY TREE: from SiteMap_CAT_00{1..4}_v2.xml (listed in robots.txt, unprotected) - 465 category URLs. COUNTS: appending ?templateInfo=true to any category URL returns that page's JSON incl. its categoryId; GET /UnbxdAPI?categoryId=<id>&returnRespAsJSON=true&isAPI=true&requesttype=ajax&rows=N&unbxdStart=S with header 'CBI-AJAX: 1' returns numberOfProducts plus the grid. This is the exact request the storefront makes, so it is the rendered header, not a raw vendor total. VERIFIED: numberOfProducts matched an exhaustive enumeration of unique product IDs on 15 nodes spanning 1 to 159 products - no divergence, unlike the Shopify/Constructor/Magento pattern. The unbxd key pair (apiKey e4664787a4e2d0943eb0159e45bb2aca / siteKey ballarddesigns-com701601521729626, storeId 10052) is exposed at /gwtResources?storeId=10052&catalogId=10551&langId=-1&key=all,checkout,pdp,app if the direct Unbxd API is ever needed. SUBSET CHECKS: 'Oversize Mirrors' (11) proved to be a pure re-cut - all 11 IDs sit inside Wall Mirrors + Floor Mirrors - so it was dropped; Wall(60)+Floor(6) union is 64, exactly the parent 'Shop All Mirrors' total. Outdoor 'Lanterns & Lighting' (21) shares 9 IDs with Lighting > Outdoor Lighting (17), so only the Lighting-branch node was taken. EXCLUDED after reading product titles: Botanicals (45, faux/topiary), Holiday, Gifts, Dorm, Fabric, Sale, New, Featured and Trends (marketing re-cuts), Pillows/Blankets/Table Linens/Rugs/Drapery panels (textiles), all Furniture, Bed & Bath, Organization/Storage, Wallpaper, Bath & Vanity lighting, bulbs/accessories, ceiling fans; 'Hooks, Cabinet Knobs & Pulls' (20) dropped as a mixed roll-up - 11 of 20 are cabinet hardware; 'Fireplace & Hearth' (2) dropped (a match cloche and a Christmas stocking stand); outdoor 'Door Decor' (16, coir doormats/stair treads), 'Garden Decor' (11, hose pots, watering can, bird feeders, incense) and outdoor 'Tabletop & Entertaining' (4, incl. a ping-pong table) dropped as functional/mixed. || RULE 0 TOP-UP ADDENDUM (2026-08-10): re-checked the site for missing room-based lighting/mirror branches (this predates Rule 0, and the original notes above show 'Bath & Vanity lighting' was excluded outright alongside bulbs/ceiling-fans - a Rule 0 violation on its face). Refetched SiteMap_CAT_00{1..4}_v2.xml fresh via curl_cffi chrome131 (465 URLs, unchanged) and searched every URL for vanity/kitchen-island/entryway/hallway/recessed/track/under-cabinet/makeup/dressing branches: only two bathroom/vanity nodes exist beyond what's already captured. (1) https://www.ballarddesigns.com/lighting/indoor-lighting/bath-vanity/ - ?templateInfo=true gives categoryId=10030 (breadcrumb Lighting > Indoor Lighting > Bath & Vanity, a same-level sibling tile next to Sconces/Chandeliers/etc., not a separate 'Lighting by Room' tree); /UnbxdAPI?categoryId=10030&returnRespAsJSON=true&isAPI=true&requesttype=ajax&rows=200&unbxdStart=0 (header CBI-AJAX:1) returns numberOfProducts=5, grid-exhausted unique IDs=5: Amelie Sconce(479483), Rose 2-Light Alabaster Sconce(675170), Brewer 1-Light Hanging Sconce(650680), Preston 1-Light Candle Arm Sconce(571306), Owen 1-Light Outdoor Sconce(560005). Cross-checked all 5 IDs against every captured Lighting row's own Unbxd ID set: all 5 already sit inside the captured 'Sconces' row (categoryId 10094, qty 37); Owen(560005) is additionally inside the captured 'Outdoor Lighting' row (categoryId 10169, qty 17). Per Rule 0.6 and the same precedent this file already applied to 'Oversize Mirrors' (a same-level sibling that was a full subset of Wall+Floor Mirrors), Bath & Vanity is a pure subset re-cut of Sconces, not new content - Rule 0 puts it back IN SCOPE as a product type, but its qty is already fully counted; no new row added, no double-count. (2) https://www.ballarddesigns.com/bed-bath/bathroom-mirrors-hardware/ ('Bathroom Mirrors & Lighting', categoryId 162458 via templateInfo) - Unbxd numberOfProducts=4, grid-exhausted unique IDs=4: Grant Vanity Mirror(769500) and Hayli Scallop Mirror(654781), both already inside the captured 'Wall Mirrors' row (categoryId 161456, qty 60); plus Owen 1-Light Outdoor Sconce and Amelie Sconce, both already accounted for per (1). Also a pure re-cut/curated cross-sell page - no row added. Also re-verified https://www.ballarddesigns.com/outdoor/decor/lighting/ (categoryId 83949) is the exact same 'Lanterns & Lighting' node the original notes above already dedup'd against 'Outdoor Lighting' - unchanged, no new node. NET RESULT: no rows added or removed (28 before, 28 after) - Rule 0 confirms both bathroom/vanity branches are legitimately in scope by product type, but both are fully-contained duplicates of rows already present, so the file's total qty was never actually undercounted by the original exclusion, only mislabeled in notes.
